items.title: Home Depot Stock Slips as Shoppers Spend More per Trip but Visit Less
items.summary: Comparable sales rose 2.2% as a higher average ticket offset fewer transactions

items.title: Home Depot Names New CEO, Raises Sales Outlook
items.summary: Home Depot appointed Chief Financial Officer Richard McPhail as CEO, effective Nov. 23.

items.title: Home Depot names CFO McPhail as next CEO, lifts sales outlook
items.summary: Investing.com -- Home Depot named finance chief Richard McPhail as its next chief executive and updated its fiscal 2026 outlook on Tuesday.
